prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Brand-new master photograph for a premium Ayurvedic hair oil animation, landscape 16:9, highest available resolution, ideally 3840x2160. Photorealistic luxury botanical product cinematography, exceptionally clear finely resolved real textures, natural warm side lighting from upper right, sunlit Indian garden courtyard, muted green leaves and ferns framing edges, softly defocused warm beige stone wall, soft bokeh. One EMPTY shallow weathered dark bronze bowl, whole bowl visible, centered horizontally, its elliptical opening centered at x50%, y62%, rim spanning x24% to76%, bowl base at y90%. Camera at slightly elevated eye level showing the EMPTY dark inner bowl. Bowl and stone tabletop tack sharp, premium natural material detail. Leave upper 50% as soft garden backdrop for ingredients to enter later. Absolutely NOTHING inside the bowl: no fruit, no nuts, no flowers, no leaves, no oil. No ingredients floating anywhere. No people, no hands, no text, no branding, no logo, no sparkle symbol, no watermark. This is a new photograph from scratch, not an upscale of a video frame.

Use case: product-mockup. Generate a photorealistic ingredient animation atlas with genuine transparent alpha background, 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized cells, landscape 3:2 canvas, high resolution 1536x1024 or larger. Exactly SIX separate isolated botanical objects, one centered per cell, each completely inside its own cell with generous clear alpha padding, occupying around 55% of its cell. Row 1: left ONE whole bright green amla fruit, middle ONE whole walnut in its brown textured shell, right ONE single shelled almond. Row 2: left ONE rich red hibiscus flower viewed at a three-quarter angle, middle ONE small lush green botanical sprig with five leaves, right THREE dried cloves in a small loose grouping. Real natural textures, sharp fine detail, product photography, warm natural soft light from upper right. Camera perspective slightly above level as if they will fall into a bowl in a garden. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no cell borders, no background, no decorative sparkle, no watermark, no ground plane or cast shadows. All six objects must be fully opaque with correctly transparent surroundings. Do not include any extra objects.

Use case: product-mockup. Create a NEW beautifully detailed premium Ayurvedic hair oil product photograph, matching the supplied garden photograph's environment and warm natural lighting. Input image role: environment, color and lighting reference only; replace the bowl with a product hero scene. Landscape 16:9 highest available resolution. One elegant tall straight-sided clear glass 100ml bottle filled with deep luminous golden oil, black cylindrical screw cap, ivory paper label with restrained sage botanical leaf illustrations and clean perfectly legible typesetting. Exact label text only: 'LUMORA' at top, 'AYURVEDIC' then 'HAIR OIL' in center, '100 ml' at bottom. No other text. Center bottle at x55%, whole bottle visible from y13% to86%, sitting on warm rustic pale stone. Around its base, one green amla fruit and half amla, a walnut, a few almonds, a red hibiscus flower and a small green leafy sprig. Lush green ferns at frame edges, sunlit warm beige stone garden courtyard defocused behind, premium gentle bokeh. Tack-sharp glass edges, cap texture, paper fibers, dew-free fruit skin and flower veins, sophisticated real product photography not illustration. Glass refraction and amber highlights physically realistic. Keep leftmost 25% quieter and softly defocused for webpage overlay text. No sparkle marks, no Gemini symbol, no watermark, no UI, no other branding. Brand-new artwork, not an upscale or copy of the old video.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied NEW LUMORA product photograph. Make the assembly-stage master. Keep the exact camera, crop, lens, background, all leaves, nuts, amla fruit, hibiscus, stone table, sunlight, bottle silhouette, bottle size and bottle location pixel-aligned as closely as possible. Remove ONLY the black cap and the paper label from the bottle, showing a completely bare clear glass bottle filled with the same golden oil. The threaded glass bottle neck must be open and clearly visible in exactly the location under the removed cap. Fill the removed cap area with the original matching garden background. Keep golden oil up to the bottle shoulder. No floating cap, no label panel, no new objects, no text anywhere, no watermark or sparkle. Preserve all other photograph detail, high clarity. 16:9 landscape highest available resolution.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Inputs: image 1 is the edit target, the newly generated bare open golden-oil bottle; image 2 is the bronze bowl identity reference. Keep image 1's exact camera, entire garden background, stone table, fruit/flower arrangement, bottle location, size and silhouette unchanged. Create the POUR stage of this scene: a matching dark hammered bronze bowl enters from upper LEFT, tilted downward toward the bottle, partly cropped by the top edge. Bowl contains a green amla fruit, walnut, almonds, a red hibiscus and green leaves. From its low right lip at about x55%,y6%, one elegant continuous translucent golden oil ribbon falls into the open bottle neck at about x59%,y18%. The stream is physically coherent, narrow at the neck and correctly aligned with the opening. Bottle is only HALF FILLED with golden oil, clear empty glass above the horizontal oil surface. Bottle remains unlabelled and uncapped. Bowl stays entirely above the shoulder of the bottle and does not hide the bottle. Ultra-sharp realistic glass refraction, golden liquid and bronze texture, consistent warm light from upper right. No hands or people. No new writing, no watermark, no sparkle. Landscape 16:9 high resolution. Preserve the original bottle/stone/plants exact alignment for animation continuity.

Use case: background-extraction. Supporting image: the supplied LUMORA bottle photograph. Produce a TWO-CELL horizontal animation asset atlas on a genuinely transparent alpha background, 2 equal square cells, 2:1 canvas, high resolution. LEFT cell: ONLY the black cylindrical cap from this exact bottle, upright front view, same satin-black material and delicate highlights, no bottle attached, no glass, no neck, centered with ample clear margins. RIGHT cell: ONLY the ivory botanical paper label from this exact bottle, front view, preserving exact sage botanical illustration and the clearly legible text 'LUMORA', 'AYURVEDIC', 'HAIR OIL', '100 ml'; label is a vertical rectangle with a subtle curved top and bottom as wrapped on a cylinder, no bottle, no liquid, no cap. Each isolated object must lie completely inside its own cell with ample transparent margins. True transparent surroundings, no colored backdrop, no floor, no shadows outside the objects, no cell borders, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no watermark or sparkle. Photorealistic high-detail materials, warm upper-right lighting matching the photo.
